Class RuntimeContext

java.lang.Object
io.github.protasm.jvmud.language.runtime.RuntimeContext
Direct Known Subclasses:
MudlibRuntimeContext
public abstract class RuntimeContext extends Object
Language operations available to generated LPC bytecode and callable values.

This contract deliberately knows nothing about worlds, connections, databases, or installation state. A host supplies an implementation and binds it through RuntimeContextHolder while executing generated code. Keeping this boundary small lets the compiler and its generated classes depend on LPC semantics rather than on a particular host.
